name: duck-trait
description: Quick fixes for duck-trait's field-based api: declare missing accessor traits in _fields.rs from the `Cmd+.` menu, or automatically when a Rust file is saved.

duck-trait.autoDeclareOnSave.markdownDescription: After saving a Rust file, automatically declare its missing `#[props]` fields in the crate's `_fields.rs` — creating the declaration file and the `mod _fields;` wiring when needed. Only runs when the crate (in a monorepo: the nearest member manifest) actually depends on `duck-trait`.

commands.title: duck-trait: Declare missing fields of this file in _fields.rs
duck-trait: Declare all missing fields of the crate in _fields.rs
